SELECT cart.cart_id AS cartId, cart.member_id AS memberId, cart.product_id AS productId, product.product_name AS productName, product.product_price AS productPrice, product.product_image AS productImage, product.product_stock AS productStock, cart.quantity AS quantity FROM cart JOIN product ON cart.product_id = product.product_id
WHERE cart.member_id = #{memberId};
